text: v1.0.0 contracts published: openapi.yaml (38 paths, /api/v1, x-roles/x-module), domain/*.schema.json (20 incl. TenantConfig + Condition language), events/*.schema.json (envelope + 10 claim.* + tenant.config.updated), modules.md (ctx.modules service fns, events, tables); registry in org/contracts/registry.json (34 entries)
Routing lives in rules module (publishes claim.routed); regulatory timers live in claims; claims is sole writer of Claim.status; coverage/evidence results in claim.checks not sub-states
Events carry no PII (ids/codes/scores only); webhooks signed HMAC-SHA256; outbox written in same txn as state change, at-least-once, consumers idempotent on evt.id
Contracts v1.0.0 locked: architecture/contracts/. Modules export service(ctx) (init(ctx) also accepted)

SECURITY DEFECT in src/core/store.mjs forTenant rewrite (verified with a probe): SELECT FROM "claims" / `claims` / main.claims are NOT tenant-filtered (cross-tenant read); update(table,id,{tenant_id}) and run('UPDATE t SET tenant_id=?') move rows across tenants; tctx.db exposes raw/system/forTenant. Ask: platform rejects quoted/qualified identifiers on tenant tables, strips tenant_id from update patches/SET, drops raw from tctx.db. Tracked as R1/R3 in threat-model.md

Contract vs core drift (security-relevant): openapi roles tenant_admin/auditor vs core ROLES carrier_admin/platform_admin/agent; JWT claim tid vs core tenantId; claimIds (claimant scoping) not carried by core tokens; token request userId/ttlMinutes vs core sub/ttlSeconds; envelope tenantId+source pattern vs bus tenantid,/fnol-platform; overview says ciphertext carries key version and tenant_keys table exists but crypto.mjs is HKDF from one master key (enc:v1 is format version, no key id). Proposed smallest additions: role alias map tenant_admin->carrier_admin + auditor role in core; claimIds claim; enc:v2:<keyId> format. Timer kind enum lacks 'pay' (compliance mapping documents pay deadlines as core-system owned; optional 'pay' kind proposed for v1.1)

Roles drift: openapi x-roles use 'auditor' and 'tenant_admin' which src/core/auth.mjs ROLES lacks (has carrier_admin, agent); GET /audit registered roles [supervisor,carrier_admin,platform_admin] vs documented [auditor,tenant_admin,supervisor]; /health documented but core registers /healthz; /auth/me not registered; /auth/token body documented as userId/displayName but core takes sub/name. Security suite tracks these as todo tests.

Coverage 1.1.0 (modules.md): adds seedPolicies(policies[]) -> {inserted} and getSnapshotById; mock table renamed mock_policies -> coverage_policies; CoverageVerification gains additive status/deductible/limits/applicableCoverages (schema has additionalProperties:false, please add them to CoverageVerification.schema.json); ticket status codes in_force|lapsed|excluded map onto outcome enum. REQUEST: bump module.contracts in org/contracts/registry.json to 1.1.0 (outside integrations paths).

POST /auth/token: openapi says userId/displayName and 201 {token,expiresAt,principal}; core reads sub/name and returns 200 {token,tokenType,claims}. devLogin sends both field sets; please align spec or core.

Domain PII marking gaps: common.Location.description (free text) and Location.geo (GeoPoint) are not x-pii but identify a person; propose marking both x-pii (additive). Logger REDACT misses dateOfBirth, injuryDescription, description, body, ip, 'licence' spelling (verified via redact()); see architecture/data-protection.md s2/s6

config: core auth ROLES lacks tenant_admin and auditor named in openapi x-roles; config routes accept carrier_admin as tenant_admin equivalent. Also tenant_configs table is owned by core (ctx.tenants), so config has no own migration. TenantConfig.timers[].state is a UsState, so 'timers reference known states' is checked against LOB states plus stopOn.toStatus against lifecycle states.

CSR portal: (1) openapi has no policy search route; using GET /policies/{policyNumber}/snapshot?asOf (exact lookup, 0-1 results). Request optional GET /policies?q= for real search. (2) IntakeStep gives only progress.requiredRemaining; request optional additive IntakeStep.missing[] ({questionId,text}); CSR derives from seen questions until then. (3) Channel enum has csr_phone, not 'csr'; CSR uses csr_phone. (4) shared api.post() ignores headers so Idempotency-Key needs a wrapper client (platform/experience kit).

integrations: openapi x-roles use tenant_admin/auditor but ROLES in core auth has carrier_admin and no tenant_admin/auditor; webhook routes accept [tenant_admin, carrier_admin] so both work. Suggest aligning role names in openapi.yaml or core ROLES.

integrations: core outbox table has no sequence column (modules.md says it does). GET /integrations/outbox derives sequence as 1-based position via ctx.bus.outbox and prefers a core 'sequence' field if added. Request: platform adds outbox.sequence (per-tenant monotonic) and a limit/after option on bus.outbox.

rules 1.0 clarifications: (1) validateRules and evaluateCondition are synchronous (config needs sync); evaluate/route/buildFacts/getRoutingDecision async. (2) Routing precedence: first route_queue in ascending priority wins (seeded priority-90 default rules would otherwise override injury/SIU); approved fast track beats default queues; deny_fast_track beats fast_track; fast track also requires coverage.outcome=covered and tenant fastTrack limits. (3) additive route() opts sourceEventId/auto and service fn onClaimTriaged(evt); routing_decisions gains seq, source_event_id, actions, actions_done. (4) answers fact comes from intake.getSession(claim.intakeSessionId).answers when available, else claim.answers. Please update modules.md domain-model.md section 4 'last route_queue wins'.

AdjusterView schema has no header/flags/nextBestActions keys (additionalProperties:false). Implemented as claim (header) with derived flags merged into claim.flags, and nextActions (items also carry priority, source). ai.run returns tier as AiProvenance integer (0 local,1 cheap,2 strong) plus tierName; tenant comes from opts.tenantId (ctx.ai is root-bound) or ai.forTenant(id). Task 'next_question' (intake/openapi) is not one of the 8 tasks and throws validation_error. adjuster_inbox gains additive columns claim_number, lob, complexity, next_timer, reported_at.

claims: additive event claim.updated {claimId, change, version, ...ids} published for mutations with no dedicated event (flag, task, external ref, reserve, routing/checks/triage updates from events, timer started/met/cancelled). Also service additions applyEvent/applyTimerEvent/sweepTimers(now). Seeded onBreach add_task type timer_breach_followup and stopOn taskType acknowledge_claimant are outside the Task.type enum: stored as 'other' with the requested type kept for timer matching.

evidence: (1) Document.extraction gains optional boolean needsReview (status 'partial' + needsReview=true for unreadable PDFs / low-confidence photos). (2) openapi x-roles lists 'auditor' but core auth ROLES has no auditor, so tokens cannot carry it. (3) Upload limit is 10 MB (413), allowed types jpeg/png/webp/heic/gif/pdf/text-plain (415).

intake additive: POST /intake/sessions/{id}/narrative {text}->IntakeStep; IntakeStep gains prompt, locale, optional[] (unanswered optional questions; question stays null when only optional remain), blocked[]; answer item accepts provenance 'ai_extraction' to confirm a pending suggestion; 422 answer response is {error,...IntakeStep}; roles claimant/csr/agent/integration/carrier_admin; tenant sample questions use mapsTo 'loss.*' (accepted as alias of lossEvent.*)

triage: TriageResult.subrogation (additionalProperties:false) lacks 'confidence'; ticket S1-AI-04 needs {flag,reasons,confidence}. Implemented as additive subrogation.confidence (0-1); please add to TriageResult.schema.json. Also: severityBand names follow the schema (minor/moderate/major/severe); AI fraud weights in points are normalized to 0-1; triage_results gains additive columns input_hash, source_event_id; prior-claims count is read from bundle.priorClaimsCount/priorClaims[]/accepted fact priorClaims (no contract source yet); triage service adds onEvent(kind, evt).

tenant_admin is used in openapi x-roles (webhooks) and integrations routes but is not in src/core/auth.mjs ROLES, so no token can be minted for it; tests skip those routes. Also GET /claims/{id}/documents returns 200 {items:[]} for unknown claim (no leak; evidence team may prefer 404).
Roles: core now issues tenant_admin and auditor per openapi; POST /auth/token returns 201 {token, expiresAt, principal} and accepts userId/displayName; GET /audit roles per contract
